items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I recommended Philly, and Philly became the drummer.

ctx.x: So you stopped driving the truck. Is that when you took up with Bull Moose Jackson?

Just about after that, yeah. I forgot Bull Moose. In fact, the first job I had after the truck driver was Bullmoose Jackson. What happened – he was looking for a saxophone player when he came through town. Somehow somebody told him about me. I went to audition. We were in the hotel room, him and the road manager who played alto with the group. So they put the music up, and I played the music. After that they said, “He doesn’t wear glasses for nothing,” which meant that I could read the music. That’s when I joined…
